scope: Training-only native domain collection. Labels are never read or used.

selection_protocol.scope: Prospective training-only native domain calibration and public analytic-function selection; not certified arbitrary-input bounds.
selection_protocol.training_split: nyu-mll/glue mrpc train all3668; labels not loaded
selection_protocol.input_contract: same pinned model/tokenizer; sequence128; padding=max_length; truncation=True; native float32 eager batch1
selection_protocol.inverse_sqrt_method: existing power degree<=32 and normalized monomial coefficient L1<=1e8, otherwise fixed Newton schedule from domain endpoints
selection_protocol.gelu_method: balanced Chebyshev on declared training-derived domain; no monomial conversion execution
selection_protocol.softmax_method: fixed degree8 exp[-.5,.5], squarings=ceil(log2(max(abs(domain))/.5)); normalize each square with public K-dependent reciprocal Newton count targeting1e-12 analytic relative error
selection_protocol.pooler_method: existing degree candidates8/12/16 tanh[-1,1] with fixed power-of-two domain reduction and rational doubling; public reciprocal domain[1,2.1]
selection_protocol.validation_policy: No validation labels or approximate validation outputs used to select domains/degrees/iterations. Freeze candidate bytes first; report every later gate/domain failure without automatic retuning.
limitations: Empirical training ranges with fixed slack are not arbitrary-input guarantees.
Native ranges do not prove approximate or encrypted trajectory coverage.
Native audit at float32; planned approximate reference may use float64 and must compare unchanged original harness gates.

limitation: Prospective domains derive only from training native ranges and the fixed historical rule; neither validation coverage nor propagated approximation/CKKS error is established.
